channel.title: The Colorado Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Colorado Sun (coloradosun.com)

item.title: Drew Litton: Colorado’s state of play
item.description: Cartoonist Drew Litton pays respects to the inordinately large number of Coloradans who are participating in the 2026 Winter Olympics.

item.title: Jim Morrissey: Colorado Cupid draws back his bow …
item.description: As Valentine's Day approaches, cartoonist Jim Morrissey — and many Colorado homeowners — aren't exactly feeling the love.

item.title: Are Flock and Palantir both owned by billionaire Peter Thiel?
item.description: No. While Peter Thiel cofounded Palantir, he has never been on Flock’s board and did not help start the company.

item.title: Woman pleads guilty to scamming nearly $5 million from Idaho Springs gondola investors
item.description: Chrisheena McGee’s guilty plea wraps a 5-year drama that includes a lawsuit, civil award, indictment and an FBI investigation that showed McGee and her partner fleeced 6 investors for more than $10 million

item.title: Colorado Capitol caucuses would have to disclose their donors, spending under Democratic unity bill
item.description: The proposal, backed by top members of the Opportunity Caucus, comes after the group faced criticism for not disclosing who paid for their Vail retreat with lobbyists last year

item.title: As Trump reverses EPA’s ability to control greenhouse gases, Colorado environmental groups vow to “play the long game”
item.description: It's a regulatory win for conservatives that will set back state's antipollution efforts and greatly impact the car and truck economy, officials say

item.title: Looking for a Valentine? These Colorado cupids are using PowerPoint to pitch their friends to other singles.
item.description: Through Pitch-A-Friend, singles are coming together in Denver and “pitching” their friends as a new way to break free from loneliness

item.title: Colorado would become first state to remove all criminal penalties for prostitution under bill brought by group of Democrats
item.description: While prostitution is legal in Nevada at licensed brothels in certain counties, and Maine decriminalized the selling of sexual services, no state has fully removed the criminal penalties for prostitution

item.title: Steamboat Springs plane crash kills 4, NTSB investigating
item.description: The crash happened late Thursday on Emerald Mountain and involved an Epic Aircraft turboprop

item.title: Judge denies request to force Children’s Hospital to resume gender-affirming care for transgender youth
item.description: Several families sued Children’s, arguing that the hospital’s suspension of gender-affirming care violated state antidiscrimination law
